study: Predefined three-dataset search for a 20% minimum-disruption advantage
selection_status: Datasets selected from source descriptions; no optimization outcomes on any of these three datasets have been observed. Previous HARTH and ExtraSensory results are known.

preprocessing.har70: All subjects and all seven source activities; modal activity per nonempty non-overlapping 5-second recorded-time bin. Retain partial bins and all observations.
preprocessing.pamap2: All Protocol files, all nine participants, all labels including transient code 0; modal label per nonempty non-overlapping 5-second recorded-time bin. Optional activities excluded because they are a distinct non-uniform optional protocol, not because of results.
preprocessing.unimib: Official processed segments and all 17 activity/fall labels, all 30 subjects, no resampling or invented groups.

fold_design: For each seed, permute sorted participant IDs with NumPy default_rng(seed), use array_split into five folds, test every ordered pair of distinct test and validation fold. Total 40 cases per dataset.
original_memberships: Test fold wholly locked; all observations from validation fold start in validation; all remaining participants start in train. Group-consistent original assignments.
comparison: Best independently valid output of all three greedy methods on the identical instance. Cases without a valid greedy answer count as failures, not movement savings. Report every attempted case.

qualification.metric: 100 * sum(greedy_changed - splitmend_changed) / sum(greedy_changed) over ALL paired valid cases from BOTH fixed fold seeds

optimality: Exhaustive participant allocation enumeration for at most 18 free groups; otherwise require solver-reported zero optimality gap and independent row audit. Preserve any time limits.
reporting: Exploratory dataset selection, not a universal or independently validated 20% claim. Preserve previous clinical evidence and the complete candidate screening. GitHub/main changes conditional on verified qualifying evidence and write availability.
